research_question: Can content-disjoint, source-diverse authentic training images reduce external real-image false positives while retaining CIFAKE transformation robustness and unseen-FLUX recall?

model_and_threshold_selection.data: CIFAKE validation plus content-disjoint SID-Set-train real validation; no test or audit data.
model_and_threshold_selection.objective: Among thresholds satisfying the SID real FPR constraint, maximize unweighted mean CIFAKE balanced accuracy across clean and all six representative transformed validation conditions.
